description: Ask for a city to join the Anecast roster: daily editions, station history and a graded forecast. Use when a place is not a roster city (the other tools still answer for it by lat/lon, as an enrolled gridpoint). One request per call; the roster is curated by hand.

city.description: the city and state, e.g. "Boise, ID"

why.description: optional: who is asking or why (helps prioritize)

name: request_city
title: Request a city
